newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH DISCOVER FIRST CASE OF MAD COW DISEASE.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH DISCOVER FIRST CASE OF MAD COW DISEASE.

text.p: The Netherlands on Friday reported its first case of Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy (BSE) or mad cow disease.
The Dutch agriculture ministry told Reuters that a single case had been discovered at a farm in Wilp in the central Netherlands.
"This is the first case of mad cow disease to be identified in The Netherlands," a farm ministry spokesman said.
He said the cow had been born in The Netherlands five years ago and had never been out of the country.
Since 1986, about 178,000 BSE cases have been confirmed in the European Union and Switzerland, according to European Commission data.
Up to the end of 1996, most of the cases -- around 172,000 -- were in Britain, followed by Switzerland with 230 and Ireland with 185.
